name: Markov Corp
creative_worldview: Intelligence that anticipates. Markov Corp builds AI that predicts the next state, so every frame is sleek, calm, and forward-leaning: a matte-black device breathing a soft violet glow on minimal surfaces, deep charcoal space, one confident accent of electric violet. Restraint signals capability - no clutter, no hype, just a quietly powerful object. Photography feels like a premium product film shot at dusk.
brief: Campaign: Markov Corp, an AI company launching a sleek matte-black desktop AI device with a soft violet accent glow. Palette lock: charcoal black, electric violet, cool off-white; low moody dusk light. Style: premium minimalist product photography, shallow depth of field, one hero subject per frame, sleek and restrained.
logo_prompt: Design the official brand logo for 'Markov Corp', an AI company. A precise geometric mark of connected state-nodes with directional links suggesting a Markov chain, with the wordmark 'MARKOV' beneath it. Palette: electric-violet gradient mark, near-black text, on a completely flat solid pure-white background. Clean vector style, centered, generous margins, no photography, no extra text.
no_text_instruction: Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, wordmarks, watermarks, buttons, or UI elements anywhere in the image.
